subject: Mutual Action Schedule & Legal Handoff — SeleneHealth Pilot Closure
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rivera <m.rivera@selenehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action schedule and sequencing question for Selene pilot

Hi Maya —

Following our call this morning, attaching an initial mutual action schedule (MAP) and a simple orderflow visual to clarify the signature sequencing we think will keep your pilot on the October window. Two quick asks:

- Can you confirm whether Selene requires the DPA to be fully countersigned before we execute the MSA + Order Form, or whether you can accept MSA + Order Form via DocuSign to lock commercial and continue DPA redlines in parallel?
- Please confirm the legal contact who will own DPA redlines (name + email) so we can route changes directly.

Proposed high-level sequence (we can adjust based on your legal preference):
1) MSA signed (DocuSign) — commercial terms locked
2) Order Form signed (DocuSign) — pilot details / pricing
3) DPA redlines completed & countersigned (within 7 business days)
4) Provisioning + SOC2 evidence handover — onboarding kickoff

Attachments: selene_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners & dates), msa_orderflow_visual.png (sequence diagram).

If you prefer, we can also create an execution path where the DPA is negotiated and pushed through first, but that may shift the provisioning date by ~2 weeks.

Thanks — looking to align on the gating so we can finalize the demo schedule.

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Maya Rivera <m.rivera@selenehealth.com>

Cc: Jonas Reed <jonas.reed@selenehealth.com>, procurement@selenehealth.com
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action schedule and sequencing question for Selene pilot

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Legal will want SOC2 and dataflow diagrams before they sign the DPA. Do you have the most recent SOC2/attestation and a short diagram we can pass to our security team?
- Our priority is commercial lock so signing MSA + Order Form via DocuSign is preferred, but our counsel will expect the DPA redlines to be completed in parallel — they rarely permit a final countersign after provisioning without an escrow or interim controls.
- Procurement: we do need an internal PO template to map to your orderform fields (will attach).

Can you update the MAP to include: explicit owner for each legal artifact, expected turnaround (in business days) for redlines, and the point at which we will cut a PO? That will help our legal/procurement sync.

Also — would you be able to accept redlines in a tracked Word doc (we prefer that) or do you want comments in a shared Google Doc?

Appreciate it —
Maya Rivera
Director, Procurement
SeleneHealth
m.rivera@selenehealth.com | +1 206-555-8873

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Maya Rivera <m.rivera@selenehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action schedule and sequencing question for Selene pilot

Maya — thanks for the detail. Quick internal note and proposal to address the counsel concern:

- Sequence we recommend (minimal legal friction):
  * Step A: Execute MSA + Order Form in DocuSign to lock in pricing and pilot scope.
  * Step B: Begin DPA redlines immediately; legal teams exchange tracked Word redlines.
  * Step C: DPA countersigned within 7 business days; if any PII-handling exceptions remain, we will apply temporary technical controls (scoped logging minimization) until DPA is finalized.

- Required evidence we can provide today: SOC2 Type II report (2026 Q2) + architecture/dataflow diagram. I will attach a visual that maps where data stores live and who has access. If your security team needs an additional compliance questionnaire (VSA/CIS), let us know and we’ll route it.

- On acceptance criteria / gating: please confirm the pilot acceptance tests you referenced on the call (latency SLA, success rate on reranking, and a discrete accuracy sample set). We’ll add those as acceptance criteria in the MAP so legal + procurement can see the gating tied to invoicing.

Attaching: msa_orderflow_visual.png (order/DPA flow)

Karthik Iyer
Contracts & Legal Operations (liaison)
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
